# Yumna Makeup

> Yumna Makeup adalah makeup artist yang berbasis di Kota Bandung, Jawa Barat.

## Business

- Name: Yumna Makeup
- Category: Makeup Artist
- Location: Bandung, Jawa Barat
- Service Area: Kota Bandung

## Services

- Wedding Makeup
- Engagement Makeup
- Graduation Makeup
- Party & Event Makeup

## Booking

Booking dan konsultasi dilakukan melalui WhatsApp.
